summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for AAIIBS iPad Lungsuran System. 13/13 pytest backend tests passed. All critical frontend flows verified: public dashboard w/ stats+charts+trace drawer, admin login (with /admin protected route redirect), iPad CRUD + duplicate rejection, code generation, teacher flow (validate → form fill → signature draw → submit → detail view w/ PDF download), single-use code enforcement.

issues: React hydration console warning: dev instrumentation injects a <span> inside <option> for dynamic ipad list. Cosmetic dev-only warning, does not affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py sets cookie with SameSite=None + Secure at all times; fine for HTTPS preview but will fail on plain-HTTP local. Acceptable given deployment context.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True: browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard. Frontend currently uses Bearer header so it works, but if cookie-only auth is ever used, restrict origins.
gen_code(6) with 32-char alphabet gives ~1B combos; while-loop for uniqueness is fine at this scale but no upper retry limit.
delete_ipad only blocks when pakta history exists; consider also warning on active codes rather than silent delete_many.
pakta submit accepts any 'signature' string containing a comma — trivial to bypass. Consider validating data:image prefix.
seed_data_creation: Test iPad TESTUI* + one active code generated via admin panel and consumed by teacher flow during UI test. Also pytest creates its own TESTSN* iPad (auto-cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py`. UI leaves a leftover TESTUI* iPad + used code + pakta in DB (not cleaned by UI test). Seeded lungsuran serial F9FZ2BBBB04 has 2-holder chain (Budi→Rina) — trace drawer verified.
